_comment: Items, per brief section 35. Only what the prologue actually hands out.
The Goblin Charm is the prologue's one deliberately mysterious item: the
script marks it 'Unknown Item', so identified is false and its real
description is withheld until a later flag reveals it. This is the pattern
every secret promotion item in brief section 31 will reuse, which is why it
is worth establishing in the first hour.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: Clears poison. Tastes worse than the poison.

items.name: Goblin Charm
items.description: A crude bone charm on a leather thong. The carving is not goblin work.
items.unidentifiedDescription: You have no idea what this is.
items.notes: Dropped by the battle 01 goblins. The carving being non-goblin is the first hint that something beyond the Wall is directing them.
